serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Welcome back!
You: Hi…
Lady Annalie: Huuuuhh? That’s weird~
You: W-what again?
Lady Annalie: You said you will come with your girlfriend, but I can’t quite see her.
#Annalie.Face.shocked
Lady Annalie: Maybe she’s just in your head?
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Have you been to a psychiatrist lately? Huh?~
#Annalie.Face.normal
You: Eh, this again?
You: I told you I will think about it, not that I would come here with her next time. 
Lady Annalie: I know, I know. I’m only teasing you a bit! Don’t be such a gloomy guy, girls hate it!
You: Thanks for the advice, but aren’t you the one who was crying about scaring your clients off not so long ago? 
#Annalie.Face.sad
Lady Annalie: Ugh! You didn’t have to remind me of this…
Lady Annalie: Alright, you won! Have mercy…
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Geez, I was only joking and yet you are trying to hurt my feelings. I can’t believe you have a girl with an attitude like this.
You: Oh come on, you started it. Like always.
Lady Annalie: Whatever! More importantly.
Lady Annalie: When can I expect you two coming here together?
